title: Culiatum
description: Official client modpack for the Culiatum server. Includes required mods for performance, combat, exploration, and QoL. Designed for compatibility with the server, easy install and updates via Modrinth.
body:
# Culiatum Modpack (Client Pack)

Official modpack for the Culiatum Server, designed to deliver the full gameplay experience with performance improvements, enhanced combat, exploration, and quality-of-life features.

This pack only includes the required client-side mods to ensure compatibility with the server. The server itself runs additional mods and configurations that are not needed on the client.

----

## Modpack Focus
- Performance optimization (Sodium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast)
- Enhanced combat (Better Combat, Combat Roll, Mob AI Tweaks)
- Exploration & content (Better Archeology, Friends & Foes, Ecologics)
- Expanded survival (Farmer’s Delight + addons)
- Quality of life (JEI, Jade, Inventory Profiles, Mouse Tweaks)
- Visual & immersion (Iris, LambDynamicLights, Sound Physics)
- Building & decoration (Macaw’s, Beautify, Dark Paintings)
- Multiplayer interaction (Simple Voice Chat, Easy NPC)
- Custom server system (culiatum-economy)

## Important
This modpack is intended only for players of the Culiatum server and was published as an archived pack for easy updates and downloads. Not all server-side mods are included here, so do not modify the pack, as it may cause compatibility issues.

## Installation
1. Download the modpack from Modrinth
2. Import it into your launcher (Modrinth App recommended)
3. Launch the game and connect to the server

---
    
### Notes
- Version: Fabric 1.21.11
- Frequently updated based on server changes
- If you encounter issues, reinstall the pack or check versions
